cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the extra dinner plate for a moment. Tell me what time the kitchen light went off.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could just ask who came over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll do this in order. Start with the time, and whether supper ended before the last bus.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: After it. We talked for hours, then I called a taxi.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now give me the taxi destination, just the street. We can leave names until I've finished with the evening.
